decisions.reason: Its documented use by a major public customer and links to over 30 governmental schemes indicate performance clearly above aspiration levels, so an expanding large firm with slack is very unlikely to redeploy these resources.

It survived the firm's 2024 pruning and fits its airport and travel compliance offering, but the lack of visible performance evidence and the potentially narrower post-launch demand make it more vulnerable than the strongest products.

This platform is close to the firm's core security and verification capabilities and remained actively marketed in 2024, suggesting results are at least satisfactory enough for a growing firm to continue carrying it.
